appearance_facts.fact: A single teal line connects ten black circular markers across the plot, starting at the top-left and ending at the bottom-right.
The leftmost marker is positioned near the top of the y-axis scale, just above the 20 gridline.
The rightmost marker is positioned near the bottom of the y-axis scale, just above the 10 gridline.
The line shows a continuous downward slope from left to right, with a slight flattening between the 2010 and 2011 markers.
Each data point is marked with a solid black circle and has a text label directly above it indicating the temperature value.
The first two markers (2005 and 2006) are at the same vertical height, indicating an identical value.
The line segment between the 2010 and 2011 markers is nearly horizontal, showing minimal change.
The overall vertical drop from the first marker to the last marker spans approximately 170 pixels on the chart.
